entities.text:
G Gangadhar, Kamareddy Dist And 2 Others vs Panchayat Secy,
Gram Panchayat
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 .  This Writ Petition is filed questioning the impugned Notice dated 26.05.2017 whereunder the respondent No.1 directed the petitioners to remove their constructions over the subject property for the purpose of widening of the road.
2. Heard the learned Counsel for the petitioners and the learned Government Pleader for Panchayat Raj and Rural Development.

3. When the matter is taken up for hearing the learned Counsel for the petitioners would submit that after filing the Writ Petition the respondents have stopped formation of road and in view of the same the cause in the writ petition does not survive and requested to pass appropriate orders.

4. In view of the submission made by the learned Counsel for the petitioners this Writ Petition is disposed of directing the respondents not to interfere with the possession of the petitioners over the subject SK,J property, without following due process of law.

If the respondents wants to acquire the land of the petitioners, they have to follow the procedure as contemplated under Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 5. Miscellaneous applications, if any, pending in this Writ Petition shall also stand closed.
